io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not cancel a document that has later documents depending on it; cancel those first, newest to oldest.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use to reverse a posted document. Cancelling restores the stock and accounting effect of the original submission.

customer_name.description: Trading name, also the record name.

io.erpbridge/examples: Add Cargills Food City as a Commercial customer in Sri Lanka.
io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Customer Group and Territory must be existing leaf values; this tool cannot create them.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use when a human asks to add a customer, for example a retail chain or a distributor.

io.erpbridge/examples: Create a stock item "DEMO-ITEM-002" in group Products with UOM Nos.
io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not create items to test connectivity; use a read tool for that.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use when a human asks to add a new Item with a known code, name, group, and stock UOM.

price_list_rate.description: Rate in the price list currency (LKR).

io.erpbridge/examples: Set Standard Selling to 850 for FG-DET-1KG.
io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not use to change a rate; delete the price and create a new one. One price per item, price list and UOM.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use to give an existing item a selling or buying rate on a price list. Prices are what makes item lists and reports look real.

io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not delete a record that carries transactions.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use only for a Customer record created by mistake, on explicit instruction.

io.erpbridge/examples: Delete the draft Sales Order SAL-ORD-0004.
io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not use on a submitted document; cancel it first.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use to remove a draft created by mistake. Drafts carry no accounting or stock effect.

io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not delete items that carry transactions.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use only for a disposable test Item, on explicit instruction.

io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not delete a record that carries transactions.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use only for a Item Price record created by mistake, on explicit instruction.

io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not delete a record that carries transactions.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use only for a Supplier record created by mistake, on explicit instruction.

selectedSchemas.name: update_document
selectedSchemas.description: Update fields on one existing document of any granted DocType

fieldname.description: A field name, or a JSON object of field names to values, for example {"customer_group":"Commercial"}.

value.description: Value when fieldname is a single field. Not used for the JSON object form.

io.erpbridge/examples: Set customer_group to Commercial on Customer Cargills Food City.
io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not use to change a submitted document's amounts; cancel and amend instead. Do not use to rename a record.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use to change field values on an existing record, for example a Customer group, an Item Price rate, or the status fields of a draft order or account.

io.erpbridge/whenNotToUse: Do not update an item without an explicit human instruction.
io.erpbridge/whenToUse: Use to change the name, group, stock UOM, stock flag, or description of an existing Item.
